verdict.rationale: Asana documents a step-by-step quick start guide that walks a developer through creating and authorizing a token and making first API calls, plus a developer sandbox that provides a temporary Asana domain. This is a guided first-run path for engineers, but it targets building an app via the API rather than setting up an Asana workspace itself. missing for 10: an in-product guided walkthrough for first-time workspace setup (projects, teams, configuration), documentation tying the sandbox to a guided setup flow, independent or hands-on corroboration of the onboarding experience
